_about: Cworkshop (cworkshop.co.uk): the decors Raf can buy cut and edged, and what their services cost. Read by src/lib/cworkshop-boards.ts for the Job Kit's Cworkshop screen and Quotes. Prices before VAT, 18 mm boards (18.5 mm for Feelwood and some woodgrains), 2800 x 2070 sheets. A board's price is the one Cworkshop's own pages showed on its 'checked' day. A service's 'source' says where its price comes from: 'website' (their own pages), 'basket' (a basket or invoice Raf sent: 'list' is their price, 'discount' the % off Raf got, 'price' what he pays, which quotes use) or 'guess' (not seen yet, 'published' false). Raf can type his own on the Cworkshop screen. Updated by the weekly check (scripts/CWORKSHOP.md).

services.label: Cutting
services.from: Their board pages: a sheet costs £47.30 more once it's on the cutting list (e.g. Greige Castello Oak £92.51, on the cutting list £139.81).

services.label: Edging, 1 mm ABS (22 mm, matched)
services.from: Your Cworkshop basket, 6 Nov 2026 (3+ sheets of Egger H1732 ST9 Sand Birch): Standard ABS edging 22 x 1 mm, £3.26 a metre put on, less your 10%. 118.3 m on that job: £347.09.

services.label: Edging, 2 mm ABS
services.from: Not seen yet: your basket only had 1 mm. My guess: the same as 1 mm until a basket with 2 mm shows it.

services.label: Hinge holes drilled (35 mm cup)
services.from: Your Cworkshop basket, 6 Nov 2026 (3+ sheets of Egger H1732 ST9 Sand Birch): HNG-35 drilling a 35 mm hinge cup hole, £2.66 each, less your 10%. 25 holes: £59.85.

services.label: Edging a narrow panel (under 65 mm wide)
services.from: Your Cworkshop basket, 6 Nov 2026 (3+ sheets of Egger H1732 ST9 Sand Birch): NRW-EDG edging one long edge of a panel narrower than 65 mm, £3.47 each on top of the edging, less your 10%. 2 on that job: £6.25.

services.label: Edging tape to take away
services.from: Your Cworkshop basket, 6 Nov 2026 (3+ sheets of Egger H1732 ST9 Sand Birch): the same 22 x 1 mm ABS on a roll for you to put on, £1.50 a metre, less 5%. 5 m: £7.12.

services.label: Fast Flow, next day
services.from: Next-day or 2-day cut and edge when they're not busy; no price on the website.

services.label: Delivery
services.from: Worked out by distance from their North or South London branch; no prices on the website.

leadTimes: Cut and edge: usually 2 to 3 working days (Fast Flow next day or 2 days when they can).
CNC (hinge holes, shapes): 5 to 6 working days.
Collection 8am to 4pm, North or South London branch; phone 0208 236 2313.
edging: 1 mm ABS (square or radius) and 2 mm ABS (radius) matched to the decor, PUR glue; paintable tape for MDF; 0.6, 1 and 2 mm real wood edging for veneered boards. Panels from 20 mm wide and 30 mm long, up to 60 mm thick.

changes.text: First list: 30 Egger boards, their 18 mm prices.

8 more added from their pages: Pewter Halifax Oak, Reed Green Woodgrain, Crystal Marble, Parona Walnut, Brown Warmia Walnut, and three cheaper Kronospan boards (Greige Castello Oak, Opera Walnut, Tobacco Craft Oak). The four of the first 30 shown on their listing pages (Cashmere Grey, Misty Blue, Natural Halifax Oak, Light Grey Chicago Concrete) hadn't changed. Cutting still £47.30 a sheet; edging, drilling and delivery still not on their website.

142 more decors added from Cworkshop's own pages (Egger and Kronospan chipboard), 180 in all: more plain colours, Egger's supermatt TM boards (19 mm only, about £138 to £201 a sheet), stone, linen and metal looks, and the cheaper Kronospan colours and woods (about £81 to £93). None of the 25 already there and read again had changed. Not in yet, of the 321 they list: 3 out of stock, 36 whose page couldn't be found, 21 whose page wouldn't show its 18 mm price and 81 their site refused to show this time; the weekly check adds them.

Edging and drilling now from your own basket instead of guesses: edging 1 mm £3.26 a metre (£2.93 after your 10%), was a £1.50 guess; hinge holes £2.66 each (£2.39), was £1.50; new: narrow panel edging £3.47 an edge and tape to take away £1.50 a metre. 2 mm edging, Fast Flow and delivery are still guesses.
